content.text: At 5 months Theo's one month out from the usual window - Health Canada puts first foods at around 6 months, and his 6-month well-baby visit is the natural moment to get the green light and talk iron-rich first foods like pureed meat or fortified oatmeal. Signs he's ready: sits with support, lost the tongue-thrust reflex, and shows interest in your food. Want the full plan? Reply YES and I'll send it.
